tasks.label: Run Django locally
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Test-Path '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe')) { python -m venv .venv; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Virtual environment creation failed' } }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip show Django gunicorn psycopg2-binary asgiref sqlparse tzdata dj-database-url whitenoise requests requests-file python-dotenv python-dateutil python-slugify django-tailwind django-browser-reload watchdog certifi charset-normalizer idna urllib3 pytz; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Dependency installation failed' } }; $env:SECRET_KEY = 'local-development-only-not-for-production'; $env:DEBUG = 'True'; $env:ALLOWED_HOSTS = 'localhost,127.0.0.1'; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Database migration failed' }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py runserver
